scripts.storybook:web:build: cross-env STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../.artifacts/native-storybook-web
scripts.native:prebuild:ios: cross-env STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true expo prebuild --platform ios
scripts.native:prebuild:android: cross-env STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true expo prebuild --platform android --no-install
scripts.native:build:ios: pnpm native:prebuild:ios && cross-env NODE_ENV=development STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true xcodebuild -workspace ios/TaleUINativeStorybook.xcworkspace -scheme TaleUINativeStorybook -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.native:build:android: pnpm native:prebuild:android && cross-env NODE_ENV=development STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_STORYBOOK_ENABLED=true ./android/gradlew -p android app:assembleDebug --console=plain
